description: Generate a video from a text prompt, and optionally from an input image (image-to-video). Async job: starts generation, then waits and polls. Video generation typically takes 1-5 minutes. The finished file is saved to disk and its absolute path is returned. If waiting times out, a polling_url is returned — pass it to check_video_status later instead of starting a new (billed) job. For image-to-video, pass first_frame_image so the clip animates from that exact picture (e.g. a still produced by generate_image). Image inputs require an image-to-video-capable model such as 'bytedance/seedance-2.0', 'bytedance/seedance-2.0-fast', or 'google/veo-3.1'.

aspect_ratio.description: Desired aspect ratio. Support varies by model; treated as a strong hint.

filename_prefix.description: Short label used in the saved filename, e.g. 'hero-banner'. Sanitized to letters, digits, dashes.

first_frame_image.description: Image-to-video: the generated clip starts on this exact image and animates forward. Accepts an absolute file path, file:// URL, https:// URL, or data: URL.

generate_audio.description: Whether the clip should include generated audio.

last_frame_image.description: Optional ending frame the clip animates toward. Same accepted formats as first_frame_image.

model.description: Video model slug, e.g. 'google/veo-3.1' or 'openai/sora-2-pro'. For image-to-video use an i2v-capable model like 'bytedance/seedance-2.0' or 'bytedance/seedance-2.0-fast'. Omit to use the configured default.

output_dir.description: Directory to save into (absolute, or ~ for home). Defaults to the configured output directory.

prompt.description: Detailed description of the desired result. Be specific about subject, style, lighting, composition.

reference_images.description: Style/content reference image(s) that guide the look without being exact frames (reference-to-video). Same accepted formats as first_frame_image.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for completion before returning a resumable polling_url.

name: generate_video

path.description: Absolute path of the saved video, when completed

polling_url.description: Pass to check_video_status to resume waiting

status.description: completed | pending | in_progress | timeout | failed | error

title: Generate Video
